declared_proposition: For arbitrary real L,c>0, define E_n=L+c/n for n>=1, d_n=(E_n-E_(n+1))_+, and S_n=(n+1)E_(n+1)-nE_n. Then E_n tends to L, every S_n equals L>0, but sum_(n>=1) n d_n diverges. Therefore the TICKET-260 summable scaled-downward-variation hypothesis is sufficient but not necessary for eventual lag positivity.
mathematical_argument: Direct subtraction gives d_n=c/[n(n+1)], hence n d_n=c/(n+1). The harmonic series diverges, so the nonnegative scaled-variation series diverges. On the other hand nE_n=nL+c and (n+1)E_(n+1)=(n+1)L+c, so S_n=L for every n. The exact replay uses L=c=1. This refutes necessity of the abstract sufficient condition; it computes no actual Guinand-Weil packet coefficient.
